integrity: The compatibility equations are reconstructed directly from the pre-Lie identity over an arbitrary field. The automorphism group is rederived from the primitive idempotents of the fixed algebra, and Burnside counting is applied only after an exact fixed-locus computation. A standalone exhaustive checker independently tests the defining identities and orbit partition over three finite fields.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats the fiber over the fixed first product \(K\times K\), not all two-dimensional compatible pre-Lie pairs over finite fields.
The quotient uses automorphisms of the fixed first product and does not identify pairs after exchanging the two compatible products.
A specialized or unindexed finite-field treatment may contain an equivalent orbit census.
title: Finite-field compatible pre-Lie moduli on \(K\times K\)
